Only one copy of NexurBots runs at a time, and the bots' group routes stay put.

## Install

**One command** in PowerShell. It installs Hermes Agent too if it's missing, checks the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and opens the app:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or by hand:** download **`NexurBots-Setup-1.8.16.exe`** below and run it. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** If you download the installer in a browser, Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. The one-command install doesn't get that prompt.
- No auto-update: install a newer `NexurBots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Changes

- **One copy at a time.** Opening NexurBots again brings the window of the copy already running, instead of starting a second copy. Two copies used to run side by side, each with its own tunnel.
- **Group routes stay on the runner.** A settings file that couldn't be read for a moment no longer moves a bot's group route back to this PC. The app keeps the last settings it read, and it writes the settings file in one step, so a reader never sees half of it.

## Older versions

Install 1.8.16 on every computer that opens a group. Older versions can still start a second copy, and can flip the bots' group routes.
